comment: Generated by generate.mjs. Every SDK must accept exactly the valid cases, with this user, and the webhook_valid cases, with this webhook, given these providers.

valid.name: a bypass token, whose email is ignored

invalid.name: HS256 keyed with our public key
the wrong key under our kid
the wrong key under its own kid
a signature from a different token
a kind that isn't a string
a key published for another algorithm
a symmetric key in the key set
a webhook token that also carries role and email
a webhook kind addressed to the app, with role and email

webhook_valid.name: a stripe delivery, with its id and signed time
a github delivery, which signs neither
a shopify delivery, which signs neither
a list of two holding the token's provider
a claim it doesn't know, ignored
signed_at spelled with a fraction of zero

webhook_invalid.name: a person's token addressed to webhooks
a provider not in the list
a provider this SDK doesn't know, listed
the provider named in another case
the provider's name in another case
the bare app id as audience
a provider that isn't a string
a pattern that isn't a string
signed_at past the largest exact integer
a workspace that isn't a string
a second provider claim in capitals
a second pattern claim in another case
a second delivery claim in another case
a second signed_at claim in another case
the wrong key under our kid
HS256 keyed with our public key
